updates.content:
Title: Users may not see chart data when using standard light or dark themes on Power BI dashboards

User impact: Users may not have seen chart data when using standard light or dark themes on Power BI dashboards.

Current status: We've identified that impact communicated in PB1489649 persists. We're working on developing a new fix that we suspect will complete by Tuesday, October 13, 2026. At that time we'll also aim to provide details on the root cause into what caused the impact to persist. 

Scope of impact: This issue may have impacted any user who was attempting to view data on a cartesian chart pinned to the Power BI dashboard with standard light theme or dark theme enabled. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 5:00 PM UTC
